decisions.scenario: Choosing a Chinese restaurant, an attraction, and a taxi

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'm looking for an expensive Chinese restaurant with a classy atmosphere.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There are several expensive Chinese restaurants. Do you have a preferred area of town?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: No. Please recommend one and give me its address and postcode.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Yu Garden is an expensive Chinese restaurant on the east side of town.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Great. What are the address and postcode?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Yu Garden is at 529 Newmarket Road, Fen Ditton, postcode CB5 8PA.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Thanks. Could you also recommend an attraction in the centre of town?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Hughes Hall is a college attraction in the centre, and admission is free.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Great. Can I get a taxi from Hughes Hall to Yu Garden at 15:30?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Yes. I can arrange a taxi from Hughes Hall to Yu Garden for 15:30.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I was hoping to find a concert hall in the west part of town.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: I only have a concert hall listed in the centre. Would you consider another type of attraction in the west?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Yes, I would consider a museum.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There are several museums in the west part of town.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Can you recommend one and give me the available contact details?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Cafe Jello Gallery is one option in the west, at 13 Madalene Street. This listing does not contain complete fee, phone, and postcode details.

turns.text: It is a four-star guesthouse in the centre of town with free parking and free internet.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: That sounds good. What is the address?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: The address is 56 Saint Barnabas Road.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I will also need a train on Tuesday.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Where will you be travelling from, and what time do you need to arrive?

turns.text: I need to travel from Leicester to Cambridge and arrive by 10:15.

turns.speaker: Assistant

decisions.scenario: Checking information about a hotel and a park

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I need some information about Cityroomz.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Cityroomz is a moderately priced hotel in the centre, on Station Road, and it offers free internet.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Thank you. Is it a hotel or a guesthouse?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Cityroomz is a hotel. Its address is Sleeperz Hotel, Station Road.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I also need information about Sheep's Green and Lammas Land Park on Fen Causeway. What can you tell me about it?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: It is a park in the south part of town, around Fen Causeway and Newnham Road, and admission is free.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Thanks, that's all I need. Have a great day!

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You're welcome. Have a great day too!
